subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw make `yieldToolResult(...)` plus `canYield` a permanent supported Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned asynchronous interaction flows?
rationale: The patch is intentionally additive and demonstrated, but accepting a new public SDK-to-runtime control plane is a product and API-ownership decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the contract
options.body: Approve this narrow opt-in yield primitive as the supported plugin extension point and merge after normal final-head checks complete.

options.title: Request a different boundary
options.body: Keep the need open but ask for a different owner/API shape, such as a more general host-control contract or a plugin-specific lifecycle seam.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Close or pause the implementation until an approved product design establishes whether plugins may request agent turn handoff.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the contract
recommendation.body: Approve this narrow opt-in yield primitive as the supported plugin extension point and merge after normal final-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing `sessions_yield` lifecycle is the runtime behavior this proposal exposes to plugins.
